title: Use the approved pixel scales as the site identity
description:
As a reader, I want the approved imbalanced pixel scales in the masthead and browser icon so the site has a recognizable identity.
Feature: Pixel scales identity
Scenario: Visit a site page
Given a built site page
When I open it in light or dark mode
Then the masthead shows the approved scales beside the site name
And the home link retains its accessible name
And the browser icon uses the pixel scales
Scenario: Read on a narrow screen
Given a mobile viewport
When I open a page
Then the icon and site name remain readable without overflowing the masthead

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed in PR #3 / merge 3764b74. The approved scales sit to the right of the wordmark at native 24px size. Header, adaptive favicon, PNG/ICO fallbacks, and home-screen icon are installed. Site build and all 23 site checks pass; replay audit passed. Live deployment is pending.
